text:
Noah (Infra): Hey team - got an invoice from Sunflare (INV-SF-314) for $16,200 dated 2026-03-22. Coupa rejected it because PO 50077 didn't match our mapping. Vendor claims the same PO that's linked to Helix. Anyone seen this duplicate PO issue?
Aisha - Procurement: Hmm PO 50077 should be owned by Helix per our active POs. Sunflare should have used PO 50102. @Sunflare Billing can you confirm which PO you were given and who requested the service?
Sunflare Billing: Hi all - portal shows PO=50077, assigned to account "Redwood-Sunflare" in our onboarding sheet. Invoice link: https://sunflare.example/inv/INV-SF-314. We were instructed by an Engops request from Jan to bill against PO 50077. We can reissue if you provide corrected PO.
Ben (Finance): This is messy. If two vendors are using same PO ID, we risk duplicate allocation. Need procurement to confirm owner and budget. We can provisionally hold payment but require GRN or a written approver from the Eng team. Noah - which team raised the request?
Noah (Infra): Engops raised it via onboarding ticket ONB-2026-77. Contact was Maya R. I thought procurement created new PO.
Maya R: I asked for a temporary PO during the pilot and procurement told me to use existing PO 50077. If that's tied to Helix, that was miscommunication. Sorry.
POBot: Scanning PO namespace... Found PO 50077 -> OWNER: Helix Inc (active). Also found a shadow entry PO_TMP_50077 created during onboarding for temporary vendor mapping. Shadow entry is NOT authorized for disbursement. Recommendation: procurement to consolidate and issue canonical PO.
Aisha - Procurement: Thanks POBot. I'll create PO-2026-500 to consolidate the pilot vendors and map legacy refs (50077, PO_TMP_50077). That will take ~4 hours. Sunflare please do not process payment until reissue.
Sunflare Billing: We can reissue same day. One question: the invoice includes a "pilot discount" line we applied. Will finance honor it if we reissue under new PO?
Ben (Finance): Yes, discounts honored if documented. For now finance can approve provisional up to $12,000 pending new PO and a confirmation email from Engops owner (Maya). Rest $4,200 on hold until PO reconciliation. Add memo "provisional - duplicate PO exception".
Samir (CFO): I approve provisional release to avoid vendor cashflow issues, cap $12k. Procurement must provide new PO and mapping before final payment. Also need vendor bank details and remit-to confirmation.
Maya R: I just emailed procurement approval: "Maya R approves Sunflare invoice for pilot work PRJ-824." Uploaded to Coupa.
Aisha - Procurement: PO-2026-500 created and linked to legacy 50077 and PO_TMP_50077. Status: OPEN. Sending PO number to Sunflare now.
Sunflare Billing: Reissued invoice INV-SF-314-R with PO=PO-2026-500 and same discount lines. Uploaded to portal. Thank you.
POBot: PO-2026-500 now linked and open. Legacy refs consolidated.
Ben (Finance): Received corrected invoice. Queuing provisional payment per CFO signoff. Holding $4,200 pending final reconciliation and double-check that Helix hasn't been incorrectly billed for these units.
Aisha - Procurement: Noted. I'll audit Helix's charges and confirm there are no overlapping invoices. If overlap found, procurement will contact Helix and reverse link.
Samir (CFO): Documenting exception and approval here for audit trail. This should be a one-off; procurement to update onboarding docs to avoid future PO shadowing.
Maya R: Thanks everyone. Closing loop on pilot. If Helix shows overlap, I'll help coordinate dispute. :white_check_mark:
